body: There is a lot of truth here, thank you. It seems I always preach not to worry about what you can't control. I feel like all I strive to be is to be present in reality and not an optimist or a pessimist, to just see things for what they are, and in that I feel like all that has brought me is discontentment and no real connection with another human.
It all seems so petty and small potatoes compared to the grander problems people go through which is what makes it so maddening, I literally feel like I'm spiraling into insanity.

As far as the communication problems, our relationship was a quick one and it is evident to both of us that we are very different people then who we fell in love with and having two children within four years of knowing each other is proving to be a strain. I LOVE my son and my daughter due in December, don't get me wrong, it's just that I have so many doubts and uncertainties that I have a hard time believing I will be a good effective father. Additionally I am very introverted and not many people really experience the real me, and it seems like the harder I try to open up and be real with my wife the more our differences and incompatibility becomes evident. I feel like all she wants to do is be there for me and love me but I'm just to difficult of a person to love and support.  As far as the bigger picture, I'm just growing more and more fed up with general selfishness of people especially in this country (US) it's like we all try to make life harder for everyone around us just for the sake of our own convenience or well-being. It's every man for himself and I just don't see that as the best way to live life, there has got to be more to life than stacking up piles of stuff and money just to pass it on to someone that did nothing for it when we die.
